create.name: Rav Doniel Katz
create.bio:
Rav Doniel Katz is an Orthodox teacher of Jewish meditation and Kabbalah and the founder and director of the Elevation Project. Born and raised in Australia, he worked in film and theatre until a year of intense spiritual awakening in his mid-twenties set him searching through many traditions. That search took him to Jerusalem in 2000, where he spent close to twenty years studying Torah and Kabbalah with the city's rabbis and later taught at Neve Yerushalayim and Aish HaTorah.

Through Elevation, launched in 2012, he draws on Kabbalah, Chassidus and Jewish ethical writing to present the tradition's map of consciousness, emotion and prayer as something to practise, not only to study. His seminars have travelled from Jerusalem and Johannesburg to London, New York and Los Angeles, and he has spoken at the Mind & Life Institute, Wisdom 2.0 in Tel Aviv and the Sinai Indaba. Today most of the teaching runs online: a monthly Mastery Program with video courses, guided meditations and live webinars, a teacher training for those who want to pass the material on, and an online sourcebook of translated texts with his commentary. His YouTube channel carries long talks on the counting of the Omer, the festivals and relationships.

courses.title: Elevation Mastery Program
courses.description: An online monthly subscription with Rav Doniel's recorded courses on Torah-based meditation, psychology and emotional transformation, plus access to the online sourcebook. The premium tier adds a weekly ninety-minute live webinar with him.
courses.price: From $49.99 USD a month (introductory); $199.99 USD a month with weekly live webinars

courses.title: Elevation Teacher Training
courses.description: A two-level training (eleven months, then nine) for people who want to teach Elevation material, built on more than sixty hours of recorded sessions, live question-and-answer webinars, weekly assignments and a study group. The next cohort's dates are still to be announced.

courses.title: Elevation Online Sourcebook
courses.description: A searchable online library of Torah, Kabbalah and Chassidic sources on meditation, consciousness and inner growth, in Hebrew and English with new translations and his commentary. Included with the Mastery Program or available alone.
